title: BACKND Base leaderboard flows
summary: Covers the current BACKND Base leaderboard system for user and guild ranking, including group-segmented leaderboards, score and data updates that refresh the leaderboard, list and personal lookups, rewards, and historical leaderboard queries. This is the recommended replacement for the legacy URank (rank) feature.
capabilities: route ranking questions to the current leaderboard family instead of legacy URank
distinguish user leaderboards from guild leaderboards
explain group-segmented leaderboards and unmarshalled return values
identify update-and-refresh flows versus read-only lookups
point URank migration questions to the leaderboard difference page
prerequisites: SDK initialization and login are complete before leaderboard calls
The target leaderboard exists in the BACKND console with its uuid available
The backing table row exists when an update-and-refresh flow is used
common_pitfalls: Using legacy URank functions for new work instead of Backend.Leaderboard
Mixing URank and Leaderboard update calls so a score lands in the NULL group as well as the segmented group
Assuming a guild leaderboard update path is identical to the user path
Expecting the /leaderboard index path to be a page; route to a specific child instead
verification_required_for: exact leaderboard method names and signatures
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the narrower source route before generating leaderboard update or reward code.
Confirm user versus guild method differences from the official page rather than assuming symmetry.
public_notes: Leaderboard is the current ranking system; the older rank/URank pages are unpublished and return 404.
Use leaderboard/difference-to-rank to guide migration away from URank.
